approval_ref: The active goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content under ponytail reuse constraints.
notes: Autodesk Submittal reports expose Review Response and Final Response fields, while the parser currently accepts only Status labels.
Reuse the existing known-value status regular expression, canonical map and workflow index; do not add XLSX/CSV scope or an arbitrary custom-response engine.
Response Time and similar prose must remain neutral, and multiple explicit responses must remain visible instead of choosing a winner.
Validation remained synthetic and offline: 616 Python, 24 UI and 11 deploy tests passed with no customer document, credential or provider call.
title: Recognize explicit Submittal response fields
objective: Recognize exact Review Response, Final Response and Submittal Response labels when they contain an existing known Submittal status, without matching response metadata or inventing precedence.
